title: Elevator

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Allows you to lift up players, cars, and items

body:
"Allows you to lift up players, cars, and items! If an item is moving on the elevator, it will weld until the final is reached. That way you can make elevators drop stuff when fully extended! "


Description

The Elevator is a structure purchasable from Illumine Designs for $3,200.

Status can be changed manually by clicking E on it, to raise up or down. Max. size is 48 x 48 x 200 studs,
min. size is 1x1x4 studs.
At maximum size, elevator can lift up to infinite studs (need verify, since players now has basement). When it is at the bottom, it is 1 stud high. Y (up) axis in scaling shows final upper position.
The set speed shows as a number when hovering over the elevator itself.

If you use a Interactor, you can trigger the elevator with logic items like a Button, Pressure Pad or etc.

  • It is impossible to install any structure on the lowered lift, it will be automatically installed at the maximum point along the Y axis.
